Enable debugging for DNS.
Enable debugging for IPv6.
Enable debugging in dhcp6.
Changes to make unit test possible.
Enable performance testing for lwIP (if enabled, arch/perf.h is included)
Custom pbufs behave much like their pbuf type but they are allocated by external code and when pbuf_free gives up their last reference, they are freed by calling pbuf_custom->custom_free_function().
